147K likes, 702 comments - tseriesfilms on October 24, 2026: "A fresh and much-awaited pairing is ready to take over the big screen! ❤️‍🔥✨🎬

@tarasutaria joins @adityaroykapur for the first time in #BhushanKumar’s intense, violent and musical love story, directed by @milapzaveri and co-produced by #ShivChanana. The ‘Untitled’ film goes on floors later this year before arriving in cinemas in 2027.
#TSeries

#BhushanKumar #KrishanKumar @adityaroykapur @tarasutaria @milapzaveri @shivchanana @neerajkalyan24 @tseriesfilms @tseries.official".
